title: Non-overlapping Intervals
statement: Return the minimum number of intervals to remove so that the rest do not overlap. Intervals that only touch at an endpoint ([1,2] and [2,3]) do not overlap.
brute_force_solution:
def eraseOverlapIntervals(intervals):
    n = len(intervals)
    best = 0
    def go(i, chosen):
        nonlocal best
        if i == n:
            best = max(best, len(chosen))
            return
        go(i + 1, chosen)
        s, e = intervals[i]
        if all(e <= cs or ce <= s for cs, ce in chosen):
            go(i + 1, chosen + [(s, e)])
    go(0, [])
    return n - best
